hierarchical.method: two-level bootstrap: training seeds, then scenarios within a seed
assumes: the training seeds are exchangeable draws from the training procedure
the scenarios are exchangeable within the evaluated range
a bias shared by ALL seeds (a flaw of the method, the reward or the environment) is invisible to this estimator - it propagates variance, not shared bias
the interval rests on 9 clusters; with few clusters it cannot resolve small differences, and the interval should be read as descriptive

naive.method: NAIVE: cells treated as independent - for comparison only, do not report

assumes: the scenarios are exchangeable within the evaluated range
the methods are evaluated on exactly the same scenarios (the pairing is real)
the training seeds are NOT accounted for here - use hierarchical_bootstrap for that

seed_spread_a.interpretation: a mean difference of the same order as this spread cannot be separated from it with the seeds at hand

seed_spread_b.interpretation: a mean difference of the same order as this spread cannot be separated from it with the seeds at hand

separability.why: the between-seed spread (7.1 points) is of the same order as the difference (6.7 points)
